# RTÉ
> Ireland's national public service broadcaster for news, sport, entertainment, TV, radio, streaming, and Irish-language content.

RTÉ (Raidió Teilifís Éireann) publishes national and international news coverage, live and on-demand audio and video, programme information, cultural reporting, and public service content across television, radio, and digital platforms.

## News
- [News](https://www.rte.ie/news/): Main RTÉ News hub for Irish, international, and breaking news coverage.
- [Ireland](https://www.rte.ie/news/ireland/): National news reporting on politics, society, crime, health, and public affairs.
- [World](https://www.rte.ie/news/world/): International news coverage, global developments, and major world events.
- [Business](https://www.rte.ie/news/business/): Irish and international business, markets, economy, and company news.
- [Politics](https://www.rte.ie/news/politics/): Coverage of Irish politics, government, elections, and parliamentary developments.
- [Analysis and Comment](https://www.rte.ie/news/analysis-and-comment/): Explainers, analysis, and commentary on current affairs and major stories.
- [Regional](https://www.rte.ie/news/regional/): Local and regional reporting from around Ireland.
- [Weather](https://www.rte.ie/weather/): Forecasts, warnings, maps, and weather updates for Ireland.

## Sport
- [Sport](https://www.rte.ie/sport/): RTÉ Sport homepage with live coverage, results, fixtures, and news.
- [Soccer](https://www.rte.ie/sport/soccer/): Football news, match reports, fixtures, and analysis.
- [GAA](https://www.rte.ie/sport/gaa/): Gaelic games coverage including football, hurling, and championship news.
- [Rugby](https://www.rte.ie/sport/rugby/): Rugby union news, fixtures, results, and team updates.
- [Golf](https://www.rte.ie/sport/golf/): Golf news, tournament coverage, and player updates.
- [Horse Racing](https://www.rte.ie/sport/racing/): Racing news, previews, results, and festival coverage.
- [Women's Sport](https://www.rte.ie/sport/womens-sport/): News and features across women’s competitions and athletes.
- [Results](https://www.rte.ie/sport/results/): Latest sports results across major competitions and events.

## Entertainment, Lifestyle & Culture
- [Entertainment](https://www.rte.ie/entertainment/): Celebrity, television, film, music, and entertainment industry coverage.
- [Lifestyle](https://www.rte.ie/lifestyle/): Features on food, health, travel, homes, and everyday living.
- [Culture](https://www.rte.ie/culture/): Arts, books, film, music, theatre, and cultural commentary.
- [Brainstorm](https://www.rte.ie/brainstorm/): Expert-led articles and analysis from academics and researchers.
- [History](https://www.rte.ie/history/): Historical features, timelines, and stories from Irish and world history.
- [Learn](https://www.rte.ie/learn/): Educational resources and learning-focused public service content.
- [Archives](https://www.rte.ie/archives/): Historical television and radio archive material documenting Irish life.
- [Entertainment News](https://www.rte.ie/entertainment/news/): Latest entertainment headlines, interviews, and programme updates.

## TV & Streaming
- [RTÉ Player](https://www.rte.ie/player/): Live and on-demand streaming for RTÉ television programmes and channels.
- [TV](https://www.rte.ie/tv/): TV schedules, channels, programme listings, and television highlights.
- [TV Guide](https://www.rte.ie/tv/listings/): Daily television listings and broadcast schedules across RTÉ channels.
- [RTÉ One](https://www.rte.ie/tv/rteone/): Channel information, schedules, and featured RTÉ One programming.
- [RTÉ2](https://www.rte.ie/tv/rtetwo/): Channel page for RTÉ2 schedules, shows, and highlights.
- [RTÉjr](https://www.rte.ie/tv/rtejr/): Children’s channel information, schedules, and family programming.
- [RTÉ News Channel](https://www.rte.ie/tv/rtenews/): News channel schedules and current affairs programming information.
- [Player Help](https://www.rte.ie/player/help/): Support information for streaming, devices, accounts, and playback issues.

## Radio & Audio
- [Radio](https://www.rte.ie/radio/): RTÉ radio homepage with stations, schedules, and audio content.
- [RTÉ Radio 1](https://www.rte.ie/radio/radio1/): News, current affairs, documentaries, and flagship speech programming.
- [2FM](https://www.rte.ie/radio/2fm/): Popular music, entertainment, and youth-focused radio programming.
- [RTÉ lyric fm](https://www.rte.ie/radio/lyricfm/): Classical music, arts, and cultural radio programming.
- [RTÉ Raidió na Gaeltachta](https://www.rte.ie/radio/rnag/): Irish-language radio programming, news, and cultural content.
- [Radio Schedule](https://www.rte.ie/radio/schedule/): Radio programme schedules across RTÉ stations.
- [Radio Player](https://www.rte.ie/radio/utils/radioplayer/rteradioweb.html#!rii=1%3A): Live web player for RTÉ radio stations.
- [Podcasts](https://www.rte.ie/radio/podcasts/): On-demand podcast and catch-up audio from RTÉ radio output.

## Irish Language
- [Gaeilge](https://www.rte.ie/gaeilge/): RTÉ’s Irish-language portal for news, media, and featured content.
- [Nuacht](https://www.rte.ie/gaeilge/nuacht/): Irish-language news coverage and current affairs updates.
- [Seinnteoir](https://www.rte.ie/player/): Streaming access to RTÉ video content, including Irish-language programming.
- [Raidió na Gaeltachta](https://www.rte.ie/radio/rnag/): Irish-language radio station with news, music, and community programming.
- [TG4 and Irish-language coverage](https://www.rte.ie/gaeilge/): Irish-language media features and related cultural coverage.
- [Gaeilge on RTÉ News](https://www.rte.ie/news/gaeilge/): Irish-language news content and selected reporting.

## Programmes & Genres
- [Documentary on One](https://www.rte.ie/radio/doconone/): Long-form radio documentaries and factual storytelling from RTÉ.
- [Drama On One](https://www.rte.ie/radio/dramaonone/): Radio drama, readings, and scripted audio productions.
- [RTÉ Investigates](https://www.rte.ie/news/investigates-unit/): Investigative journalism and in-depth public interest reporting.
- [Nationwide](https://www.rte.ie/tv/programmes/nationwide/): Programme page for stories from communities across Ireland.
- [Prime Time](https://www.rte.ie/news/primetime/): Current affairs programme coverage, reports, and investigations.
- [The Late Late Show](https://www.rte.ie/entertainment/the-late-late-show/): Programme hub for Ireland’s long-running chat and entertainment show.
- [Fair City](https://www.rte.ie/tv/programmes/fair-city/): Soap drama programme information, cast updates, and episode content.
- [News2day](https://www.rte.ie/learn/news2day/): News service and educational current affairs content for younger audiences.

- [About RTÉ](https://about.rte.ie/): Corporate information about RTÉ, governance, strategy, and public service role.
- [RTÉ Presspack](https://presspack.rte.ie/): Press releases, programme publicity, and media resources.
- [Careers](https://about.rte.ie/working-with-rte/): Employment information and opportunities at RTÉ.
- [Contact RTÉ](https://about.rte.ie/contact/): Contact details and audience information for RTÉ services.
- [RTÉ Supporting the Arts](https://about.rte.ie/supporting-the-arts/): Information on RTÉ’s arts initiatives and cultural partnerships.
- [Accessibility](https://about.rte.ie/accessibility/): Accessibility information for RTÉ digital and broadcast services.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://about.rte.ie/terms-and-conditions/): Legal terms governing RTÉ websites and services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://about.rte.ie/privacy-statement/): Privacy and data protection information for RTÉ users.
